sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: WIP.2's `initAreaFlagRegionObserver` still didn't correct page 2..Max rows even though the flag icon was confirmed to visually render for them. The observer only watched `attributes` mutations (the flag-decorating userscript setting `data-flag-processed` on the existing anchor); if it instead replaces the anchor/cell subtree wholesale (e.g. via `innerHTML`), that fires no attribute-mutation event on the new node at all, so no code path ever caught it. Now also watches `childList` mutations, and additionally runs a bounded set of full re-checks (immediately, then at 500/1500/3000/6000ms after render) as a belt-and-suspenders fallback independent of which DOM strategy the userscript uses. Also added `sa_enable_debug_logging`-gated diagnostics at each decision point (no trio found on a table, cell missing, country not resolved, country not in the list) so a next investigation has concrete evidence instead of another guess.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The WIP.1 country-specific Locality/Region override only worked for the current page's rows: pages 2..Max are parsed from a detached `DOMParser` document (see `fetchHtml`) that flag-decorating userscripts ("More Flags Everywhere" / "Canadian Province Flags Everywhere", @Lotheric) never touch, so `splitLocation`/`splitArea` never saw the subdivision flag icon at extraction time for those rows — even though the userscript does correctly decorate them once they're inserted into the live table. Added a `MutationObserver` (`initAreaFlagRegionObserver`, installed after every `renderFinalTable`/`renderGroupedTable`, mirroring the existing jesus2099-treleases observer) that watches for the `data-flag-processed` attribute the flag userscripts stamp on processed anchors, and moves the Locality value to Region reactively the moment it's decorated — regardless of which page it came from. The correction is applied to both the visible row and its master row (`allRows`/`groupedRows`), so it also survives later sort/filter re-renders.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: `splitLocation`/`splitArea` now apply an optional country-specific override: if the area link that would become `Locality` (the first/most specific one) is decorated with a subdivision flag icon by a separately-installed userscript (e.g. "MusicBrainz: More Flags Everywhere" or "MusicBrainz: Canadian Province Flags Everywhere", @Lotheric) — meaning no city/locality was ever entered, only a bare state/province — it is routed to `Region` instead. New setting `sa_area_flag_region_countries` (🌍 AREA / LOCATION COLUMN SPLITTING section) lists which countries this applies to, matched against the row's resolved Country; defaults to `United States` only. Leave blank to disable entirely. Fixes e.g. a US artist whose only Area is "Florida" showing up under `MB-Locality` instead of `MB-Region` on `/area/<mbid>/artists`.
